menu.title: Menu
menu.delete_menu_confirm: Delete {{name}} with all its categories and items ({{count}} items)? This cannot be undone.
menu.scheduled_note: Shown at set times only (time windows: {{count}}).
menu.schedule_intro: For example breakfast from 07:00 to 11:00. Times are in the restaurant's time zone.
menu.past_midnight: Runs past midnight into the next day.
menu.name: Name
menu.summary_hint: Shown under the name in the list
menu.no_categories: No categories yet. Add one to start.
menu.delete_category_confirm: Delete {{name}} and its items ({{count}})? This cannot be undone.
menu.item_editor: Edit the item's details, prices, add-ons and tags.
menu.delete_items_confirm: Delete the selected items ({{count}})? This cannot be undone.
menu.percent_hint: Use a minus sign to lower prices, e.g. -5.
menu.sizes_hint: With sizes, guests see each size's price and the list shows the lowest one.
menu.addons_hint: Choices guests can add, such as extra toppings. They are shown as information only.
menu.show_photo_off: Hidden: the photos stay saved, guests don't see them. Switch on to show them again.

pdf.title: Printable menu (PDF)
pdf.intro: An A4 menu in your colour and style, from the same dishes and prices as your online menu. Sold-out and hidden dishes are left out.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Each branch has its own menu address, tables and QR codes. Prices and availability can differ per branch.
branches.name: Name
branches.slug_hint: Part of the branch menu address: yoursite/restaurant/this-part.
branches.slug_main: The main branch opens at your restaurant's own address.
branches.delete_desc: Its tables are removed and its printed QR codes stop working. This can't be undone.
branches.tables_hint: Every table gets its own QR code. Print the cards and place one on each table.
branches.delete_table_desc: Its printed QR code stops working.
branches.overrides_hint: Leave a price blank to use the main menu price.
branches.no_items: The menu has no items yet.
branches.overrides_saved: Saved. Guests at this branch see it now.

info.title: Restaurant info
info.description: What guests see under “Info & opening hours” on your menu.
info.about_hint: Leave a field empty to hide it.
info.hours_hint: Add a second time for a break. A closing time earlier than the opening time runs past midnight.
info.uses_restaurant_hours: This branch uses the hours for all branches. Add times to give it its own.
info.use_restaurant_hours: Use the hours for all branches
info.closures_hint: Guests see “Closed today” and a notice before the dates.

import.title: Import & export
import.intro: Move your menu in and out with a spreadsheet (Excel or CSV).
import.export_intro: Download every menu, category and item in the import format.
import.import_intro: Add or update many items at once. You'll see a preview before anything is saved.
import.how_match: Items are matched by menu, category and item name in the main language ({{language}}).
import.how_blank: An empty cell keeps the current value.
import.how_lists: Tags and allergens: separated by commas, e.g. vegan, spicy · milk, gluten.
import.fix_first: Rows with errors: {{count}}. Fix them in the file and upload it again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your own account: name, language, password and sign-in security.
settings.email_changed: Saved. Confirm the new address with the link we emailed.
settings.profile_intro: Your name and email, and the language of this app.
settings.twofa_intro: After your password, also enter a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
settings.twofa_scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
settings.twofa_qr: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.twofa_codes_intro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in once if you lose your phone.
settings.confirm_password_intro: For your security, enter your password to continue.

team.title: Team

role_hint.manager: Managers edit the menu, branches and settings, and can invite staff.
role_hint.staff: Staff mark items sold out. Allow them to edit prices if needed.

team.invite_intro: We will email them a link that is valid for 7 days.
team.pending_intro: Invitations that have not been accepted yet.
team.remove_confirm: Remove {{name}} from the team? They lose access right away.
team.leave_confirm: Leave {{restaurant}}? You will need a new invitation to come back.

qr.title: QR codes
qr.description: Print these codes for tables, windows and flyers. A printed code keeps working even if you change your address.
qr.tables_hint: Four cards per A4 page, with cut lines. Add tables on the Branches page.
qr.extra_hint: For a flyer, poster or the window — counted separately in Insights.
qr.label: Name
qr.delete_desc: Printed copies stop working. The code is never reused.
qr.print_tip: Printing tip: print at 100 % size (no “fit to page”), on matt paper, at least 3 cm wide. Test-scan one card before printing many.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.description: Specials and announcements at the top of your menu. Set dates and they appear and disappear by themselves.
promotions.item_hint: Guests can tap the special to see this dish.
promotions.delete_desc: It disappears from the menu right away.
promotions.empty: No promotions yet. Add a special or an announcement.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.intro: Reusable choices such as extra toppings or milk type, linked to items in the item editor.
addons.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}? It is removed from the items that use it ({{count}}).
addons.choices_hint: Shown to guests as information, for example "choose up to 2".

tags.title: Tags
tags.own_intro: Your own labels, such as "Chef's pick".
tags.none: No tags of your own yet.
tags.name: Tag name
tags.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}}? It is removed from all items.

photo.label: Photo
photo.heic: iPhone HEIC photos can't be used. Choose "Most Compatible" in Settings › Camera › Formats, or pick a JPEG.
photo.type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
photo.crop_intro: Drag to move, use the slider to zoom.
photo.photos_hint: Up to {{max}} photos. The first one is the main photo; guests swipe through the rest.
photo.upload_failed: The photo could not be uploaded. Check the connection and try again.
photo.full: This dish has {{max}} photos. Remove one to add another.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: How guests use your menu. Counted without cookies and without storing anyone’s address.
insights.per_day_hint: A view is one opening of your menu page; a scan is a view that came from a QR code.
insights.chart_label: Bar chart of menu views and QR scans per day
insights.top_items_hint: How often guests opened each dish's details.
insights.scans_hint: Which tables and posters bring guests in.
insights.nothing_yet: Nothing counted yet in this period.
insights.privacy: Search engines, link previews and speed tests are not counted. Numbers update within a minute.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.sold_out_hint: Guests see these as sold out. Tap when they are back.

w.error: This part could not be loaded.
w.setup_hint: A few steps make your menu ready for guests.
w.missing_hint_one: {{count}} dish has no photo. The most viewed come first.
w.missing_hint_other: {{count}} dishes have no photo. The most viewed come first.
w.orders_hint: Counted anonymously on guests' phones. Not real orders.
w.average_one: Average list {{price}} ({{count}} shown to a waiter)
w.near_limit: Almost at your plan's limit. Ask us about a bigger plan.

drawer.title: Display
drawer.intro: Adjust how the admin looks on this device.

subscription.grace: Your subscription has expired. Renew by {{date}} to keep editing.
subscription.read_only: Your subscription has expired. The admin is read-only until you renew; the menu goes offline on {{date}}.
subscription.unavailable: Your subscription has expired and your menu is offline. Renew to bring it back.

no_restaurant.title: No restaurant yet
no_restaurant.text: Your account is not part of any restaurant. Ask an owner or manager to invite you, then open the link in the email.

impersonation.until: Until {{time}}. Everything you do is recorded.
